notes: What a candidate bundle records as tested, copied into its manifest by the bundle builder. Add a value only after a recorded run on that exact version (ADR-009). steamos entries may omit build_id to cover every build of a version. gamescope and steam_client are the exact strings that `gamescope --version` and the Steam client manifest report; `dosplex preflight --json` on the device prints them. Taken from the project notes: the Deck ran SteamOS 3.9.2 build 20260925.101 with Gamescope 3.16.30; the Steam Machine ran SteamOS 3.8.28 with Gamescope 3.16.23.6 (both 3.16.23 and 3.16.23.6 are listed because its exact `--version` output was not recorded). Steam client 1791415817 ran the never-restart check on the Deck (2026-10-09) and 1788652215 ran the owner's Steam Machine build of 2026-10-08 17:03; the Steam Machine reports SteamOS 3.8.28 build 20260922.1. Steam client 1792618285 (stable, 2026-10) ran the preview29 rounds: Deck 2026-10-28 (both sides, controller checks base/kill-main/transfer/sweep, game launch and exit, Desktop mode) and Steam Machine 2026-10-29 (both sides, games, Dosplex menu, Desktop mode and back, a guarded sleep and wake).
